name: powershell.exe
commandLine:
"C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
$since=[DateTimeOffset]::Parse('2026-11-15T01:48:59Z').UtcDateTime; $all=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(node|chrome|msedge)\.exe$' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'civilization-build-preview-|build-preview-test|18244|18246|scripts[\\/]perf-hillclimb[\\/]|ms-playwright' }; $rows=@($all | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{pid=$_.ProcessId;parentPid=$_.ParentProcessId;createdUtc=$_.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o');commandLine=$_.CommandLine;createdDuringFinalVerify=($_.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime() -ge $since)} }); $rows | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Set-Content -LiteralPath artifacts/perf-hillclimb/final-proof-20261115/verification-recovery-inventory-confirmed.json -Encoding utf8; $rows | Select-Object pid,parentPid,createdUtc,createdDuringFinalVerify | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; if(@($rows | Where-Object { $_.createdDuringFinalVerify }).Count -gt 0){throw 'Resolve current verification children before another workload'}; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath artifacts/perf-hillclimb/final-proof-20261115/isolated-build-preview-r1.log){throw 'Do not duplicate isolated reproduction'}; node scripts/build-preview-test.mjs *> artifacts/perf-hillclimb/final-proof-20261115/isolated-build-preview-r1.log; $testExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Set-Content artifacts/perf-hillclimb/final-proof-20261115/isolated-build-preview-r1-exit.txt $testExit; Get-Content artifacts/perf-hillclimb/final-proof-20261115/isolated-build-preview-r1.log -Tail 12; exit $testExit"
